podcasts.title: 381 - Crystal Lake
podcasts.transcript: Crystal Lake is the hit new prequel series to the Friday The 13th franchise. The sound team had tricky tightrope walk, to find the tone of the original series but also make it something new as well. The show is a great mix of drama, horror and comedy and the audio post team was tasked with guiding the viewer through all this with sound design that is both over the top and extremely subtle. Supervising Sound Editors/ Re-Reording Mixers Steve "Major" Giammaria and Nicholas Renbeck walk us through their fantastic work on Crystal Lake. ______ Come out to Audio Post MX in Mexico City on Oct 29th! For Full details and to register to attend go to: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeSK9dYGm0rfAxP9cHGCNdkkiTdZEm7s-UmumDE9vNkw1mBjQ/viewform _______ Check out the full schedule at this year's, completely free to attend, SonicDays Conference in Denmark. https://sonicdays.com/ ________ Register for The Tonebenders/ Film Sound Sweden / MPSE event in Stockholm here: https://mpse.org/event-6887830 ________ SPONSORS: The Sound Ideas Black Friday sale is coming back this November, with some of the biggest offers of the year on the way. Expect incredible sound savings, plus new weekly specials featuring select libraries at some of their best prices yet. It all starts November 2nd, so keep an eye on Sound Ideas, you won’t want to miss what’s coming.
